plan.notes: Source: Ocean County College 2026-2027 Academic Catalog (official, catalog.ocean.edu), Associate in Applied Science in Nursing, 'Plan of Study Grid' + General Education Requirements + Program Specific Courses tables. First Semester 4-credit chemistry row offers CHEM 180 & 180L OR CHEM 181 & 181L as alternatives; transcribed as one choice slot with both options. The catalog's General Education table lists two unspecified 3-credit rows after BIOL 131: footnote 1 recommends MATH 156 for the first, the second is unlabeled; transcribed as choice placeholders in grid order (Third Semester = math elective, Fourth Semester = gen-ed elective). Nursing clinical sequence NURS 175 -> 176 -> 273 -> 274 is sequential per program design; A&P II follows A&P I; ENGL 152 follows ENGL 151.
